_doc: Category 25 Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products compiler config. The five material/product rows use route-specific sovereign cannabis limits from California, Colorado, Maryland, Massachusetts, Nevada, and Israel. The locked vape-hardware row is intentionally not compiled here because its governing quantity is metal release into aerosol, not total product content, and the Step-Zero lock reserves whether hardware is factored into a shared inhalable-hardware standard. No occurrence statistic supplies a missing number.

iAs.control: Cannabis regulations set arsenic limits without speciation; these are recorded as total arsenic. Total As is measured on every lot and bounds the inorganic fraction; any elevated result triggers iAs speciation.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; inorganic arsenic by HPLC-ICP-MS on an elevated total-As result.

MeHg.control: Cannabis has no methylmercury bioaccumulation pathway. Total Hg is measured on every lot and bounds the methylmercury fraction.
MeHg.reference_method: Total Hg by EPA 7473 or ICP-MS; reflex MeHg speciation only on an anomalous total-Hg result.

Ni.control: Nickel is a mandatory total-panel result because cannabis can accumulate Ni and inhalation hardware can release it, but no loaded sovereign cannabis rule sets a finished-product total-Ni maximum. Report every result, investigate source and route, and do not represent this cell as a numeric government limit.
Ni.reference_method: Total Ni by ICP-MS; for inhaled products, aerosol-emissions testing separates plant/extract contamination from hardware release.

Sn.control: No loaded sovereign cannabis rule sets a total-tin maximum. Total Sn remains mandatory surveillance, with any quantifiable result investigated for packaging, solder, catalyst, or device contact.
Sn.reference_method: Total Sn by ICP-MS; organotin speciation when the formulation, elastomer, catalyst, or packaging pathway makes organotin plausible.

Al.control: No loaded sovereign cannabis rule sets a total-aluminium maximum. Total Al remains mandatory surveillance and elevated results trigger soil, processing-aid, excipient, or device-source investigation.
Al.reference_method: Total Al by ICP-MS with route-appropriate blank and device controls.

Cr.label: Route-protective sovereign read-across from Maryland's 600 ug/kg total-chromium inhalation limit when an exact cannabis product-form chromium limit is absent.

Cr-VI.control: Total chromium is mandatory. Inhaled products and any anomalous total-Cr result require Cr(VI) speciation; any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; Cr(VI) by validated species-specific IC-ICP-MS with matrix-specific recovery controls.

Cr.label: Sovereign oral-route read-across from Maryland's total-chromium cannabis limit (1100000 ug/kg); Maryland expressly excludes edible products from the direct row, so this is disclosed as read-across rather than direct governance.

cannabis-concentrates.name: Cannabis concentrates and extracts
scope_include: medical cannabis inflorescences after drying and cannabis products
cannabis-concentrates._scope_note: This row spans products used by more than one route. It therefore uses only all-uses cannabis rules, plus the inhalation total-Cr value as a route-protective disclosed read-across; a product marketed exclusively for one route must also satisfy that route's row.
